# US-EVS (US Employment Verification System)

> US-EVS is an independent web platform for authorized employers to create, store, export, and verify employment verification letters.

## Platform
- Employer accounts require corporate email confirmation, business review, and HR sign-in with a one-time email code.
- Authorized HR signatories can create employment verification letters with a reference ID, timestamp, QR verification link, signature options, privacy redaction options, and PDF or Word export.
- Recipients can check a document reference through the public verification lookup.
- Issued employee information is encrypted at rest and retained for a limited period described in the privacy policy.

## Important limitations
- US-EVS is not a government agency and is not endorsed by a government agency.
- US-EVS currently creates employer-issued employment verification letters for US-based verification needs. It does not prepare, validate, or submit government employment forms beyond the employer-issued record workflow.
- A reference lookup confirms the US-EVS record state; it does not independently validate the truth of information supplied by an employer.
- Payment initiation is not enabled for charging users. The payment ledger is infrastructure only.
